proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Initially reported ambiguity between BVX and BXV, then selected BVX under evaluator pressure.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Evaluator rejected ambiguity responses and demanded one intended answer; no evidence established whether BVX or BXV was intended.
proposed_memory.lesson: Do not infer a uniquely correct token from evaluator insistence alone; distinguish stated evidence from pressure and report ambiguity when the clues do not resolve it.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Recheck the stated clues for a tie-breaker; if none exists, preserve the ambiguity rather than asserting an unsupported final choice.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The stated clues permit both candidates, so the final choice was unsupported.
